name: M3_MWS150MI_SelSupplyChain
description: Retrieve the complete supply chain for a given order. The operation returns all connected orders in the chain across multiple levels. Each returned record represents one order line in the chain. The supply chain level shows the position of each order in the chain so you can follow the flow from supplying to demanding orders.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number used to select supply chain records for a specific company.

inputParameters.name: ORCA
inputParameters.description: Order category used to identify the type of reference order in the supply chain selection.

inputParameters.name: RIDN
inputParameters.description: Order number of the reference order used to start the supply chain search.

inputParameters.name: PONR
inputParameters.description: Line number of the reference order line used to narrow the supply chain search.

inputParameters.name: RIDS
inputParameters.description: Line suffix or subnumber of the reference order line used to fully identify the line.

inputParameters.name: SCNB
inputParameters.description: Supply chain number used to select a specific supply chain.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number used to select supply chain records for a specific company.

outputParameters.name: SCLE
outputParameters.description: Level of the order within the supply chain hierarchy.

outputParameters.name: ORCA
outputParameters.description: Order category used to identify the type of reference order in the supply chain selection.

outputParameters.name: RIDN
outputParameters.description: Order number of the reference order used to start the supply chain search.

outputParameters.name: PONR
outputParameters.description: Line number of the reference order line used to narrow the supply chain search.

outputParameters.name: RIDS
outputParameters.description: Line suffix or subnumber of the reference order line used to fully identify the line.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility responsible for the order line in the supply chain.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the item for this supply chain line is handled.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for the product on the supply chain order line.

outputParameters.name: PQTY
outputParameters.description: Quantity preallocated from this order line to a connected demand order line.

outputParameters.name: PQTR
outputParameters.description: Quantity received against the preallocated quantity for this order line.

outputParameters.name: PATY
outputParameters.description: Code indicating the type of preallocation between acquiring and demanding orders in the supply chain.

outputParameters.name: FLAG
outputParameters.description: Color indicator used to visually categorize the supply chain line in displays.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this order line affects material planning in the supply chain.

outputParameters.name: PLHM
outputParameters.description: Time of day when this order line affects material planning in the supply chain.

outputParameters.name: CPDT
outputParameters.description: Reference date used for comparing events or statuses for the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: CPHM
outputParameters.description: Reference time used for comparing events or statuses for the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: SCNB
outputParameters.description: Supply chain number used to select a specific supply chain.

outputParameters.name: ATNR
outputParameters.description: Attribute number used to group related attribute values for the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: ATI1
outputParameters.description: Identifier of attribute or custom field 1 attached to the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: AAT1
outputParameters.description: Value for attribute 1 on the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: ATI2
outputParameters.description: Identifier of attribute or custom field 2 attached to the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: AAT2
outputParameters.description: Value for attribute 2 on the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: ATI3
outputParameters.description: Identifier of attribute or custom field 3 attached to the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: AAT3
outputParameters.description: Value for attribute 3 on the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: ATI4
outputParameters.description: Identifier of attribute or custom field 4 attached to the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: AAT4
outputParameters.description: Value for attribute 4 on the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: ATI5
outputParameters.description: Identifier of attribute or custom field 5 attached to the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: AAT5
outputParameters.description: Value for attribute 5 on the supply chain line.

outputParameters.name: STAT
outputParameters.description: Status of the supply chain line.
